name: Workspace Manager Pro
blocker: Revalidating the hardware-reported Workspace Manager PI race fixes after aligning their regression assertions. Physical Rat Dev hardware QA remains the release boundary. Marketplace submission and shipping are not authorized.
release_gate: Standalone Pro-only product source created under streamdeck/workspace-manager-pro/0.1.0.0/source
Plugin UUID com.packrat.workspacemanagerpro and action UUID com.packrat.workspacemanagerpro.workspace are distinct from all published Window Manager Pro identifiers
Validated Window Manager Pro 1.2 workspace/model/native engine reused from source commit 577e9ff0c69b0c5d062a77745e481e8669728cf1
Named shared workspace create/capture/rename/duplicate/delete flow preserved

Entire-desktop restore, optimal one-to-one matching, same-app multi-window handling, monitor remapping, window state handling, safe missing-app launch, duplicate-launch prevention, retry, partial-failure and progress/results logic preserved
Windows/macOS model/native/workspace regression tests copied into the standalone source and new identity/design tests added
Canonical PackRat Stream Deck design applied locally; standards/streamdeck-plugin-design-system-v1.md remains read-only
Rat Dev external registration added for rat dev workspace-manager-pro
Plugin-level PNG preference icon corrected after validator feedback; 256x256 and 512x512 assets now included
Window Manager Lite Property Inspector layout/row/button formatting adopted for Workspace Manager Pro hardware QA
Canonical Property Inspector transport contract applied: uiUuid settings context, separate actionContext, debounced Saving/Saved persistence feedback, global streamDeck.ui command/state channel
New/Capture/Rename/Duplicate/Delete now show immediate in-inspector progress and completion/error feedback

Final pre-hardware hardening: flush debounced settings on PI close, preserve pending edits, command watchdog, stale-workspace guards, empty-workspace restore guard, zero-window capture warning, shared-key refresh, and deleted-workspace reference clearing
Canonical real PackRat PNG asset copied from the validated Window Manager Lite implementation; substitute PI SVG removed
Public QA bridge now runs the shared streamdeck-plugin-design-audit with --require-canonical-pi and streamdeck-key-visual-audit on both Windows and macOS
Static fallback Workspace key border increased from 3 px to 4 px so the shared key visual audit has no thin-stroke warning at 144 px source scale
Canonical streamdeck-plugin-design-audit --require-canonical-pi: PASS with 0 errors and 0 warnings on Windows + macOS
Canonical streamdeck-key-visual-audit: PASS with 0 structural errors and 0 warnings on Windows + macOS

Hardware-reported PI races fixed: pending workspace selection can no longer be overwritten by stale state; rename uses a local draft that survives state refresh; authoritative plugin state now clears Saving… once persisted
Future workspace names are unique by default; duplicate existing names are disambiguated in the dropdown with ordinals and window counts
Private-source revalidation requested for exact source commit dfc05adab8a2bec15899fb53d542ac69cf82f298
final_boundary: Run rat dev workspace-manager-pro on the real Windows/Stream Deck host. Verify Retry persists after close/reopen, New/Capture/Rename/Duplicate/Delete show immediate and completion feedback, empty/stale workspaces fail clearly, captured window/app summary updates, and multiple Workspace keys retain independent selections. Review representative runtime keys at real 72 x 72 hardware scale. Keep this product out of Marketplace submission/ship until that hardware QA is explicitly accepted.
notes: Standalone Pro-only product with no Lite edition. This is a new future Marketplace identity and must never reuse Window Manager Pro Marketplace/product/action identifiers. Window Manager Pro source and control-plane metadata are not modified by this product registration.
